methods.name: PCA on the SVD path (n <= 4p), with fewer components than min(n, p)
methods.reference: stats::prcomp(x) (center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE) and summary()'s proportion of variance
quantities: proportion of variance (all components and the kept ones)
methods.tolerance: sdev, proportion and total Tol::stat(n) (n = 20, 6); rotation Tol::coef(20); the roundoff sixth sdev of the 6 x 10 data abs 1e-12

methods.name: Classical MDS: R's GOF pair and add = TRUE (Cailliez's additive constant)
methods.reference: stats::cmdscale(d, k, eig = TRUE, add = FALSE | TRUE)
methods.tolerance: GOF, ac and points Tol::coef(n) (n = 21, 8); eig rel 1e-9 with abs 1e-6 (eurodist), abs 1e-5 (eurodist with add: the null eigenvalue moves with the roundoff of ac), abs 1e-9 (Manhattan)

methods.name: t-SNE: bhtsne's exact path with Rtsne's optimiser (exaggeration 12 to iteration 250, eta 200)
methods.reference: Rtsne::Rtsne(theta = 0, pca = FALSE, normalize = FALSE, Y_init, eta = 200, exaggeration_factor = 12, stop_lying_iter = 250, mom_switch_iter = 250)
quantities: embedding after 1 and 10 iterations from a given start
methods.tolerance: 1 iteration rel 1e-10; 10 iterations rel 1e-9 and abs 1e-9 (the summation order separates the paths at about 1e-13)
